main.description: A proposed change to a workspace keyring. Written by a manager to their own PDS when they can't directly modify the owner's keyring record. The owner's daemon applies pending updates via the AppView.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the app.opake.* namespace.

keyring.description: AT URI of the target keyring.

encryptedMetadata.description: New encrypted keyring metadata. Used by rename and updateDescription actions. Encrypted with the current group key by the proposer.

memberDid.description: Target member DID for addMember, removeMember, and updateRole actions.

memberPublicKey.description: X25519 public key of the member being added. Required for addMember so the owner can wrap the group key.

role.description: Role to assign for addMember and updateRole actions.
